# Anton Alekseev — Senior Product Designer

> Anton Alekseev is a Senior Product Designer based in Petah Tikva, Israel, with 9+ years in B2B SaaS. He translates complex B2B systems into self-service experiences that scale: data-dense platforms, InsurTech, AI features people can trust, and design systems built for AI-agent development. Open to work.

- Site: https://antonalekseev.design/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/atoshik
- Email: aa.nooker@gmail.com
- Languages: English, Hebrew, Russian

## Experience

- Kissterra — Senior Product Designer (Jul 2022 – Jul 2026). Four years on MarketingOS (Beacon, Growth, Connect), a real-time analytics and bidding platform used by top U.S. insurers; the last two as its only designer. Shaped product growth from $8M to $30M+ in monthly media investment.
- Camilyo — Senior Product Designer (Jan 2021 – Jul 2022), Product Designer (Mar 2017 – Jan 2021). All-in-one platform for small service businesses; grew from an early product designer into the lead of a design system shared by 5 designers and 50 engineers.
